dedupe_keys.name: granulometric database of individual fragments of shredded waste electric and electronic equipments

description: Alexis Barthet and collaborators at Mines Paris and Chimie ParisTech publish measurements of individual fragments from two batches of shredded electrical and electronic waste. The free Zenodo ZIP uses CC BY-SA 4.0. The 2021–2022 collection pairs original and segmented photographs with fragment mass, density, type and estimated length, width and thickness. Image-specific millimetres-per-pixel values support further measurement. These properties can calibrate particle sampling and separation components in waste-recovery simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this granulometric database. Coverage is two sampled batches, not the full composition of municipal or industrial WEEE streams. Segmentation error, irregular fragment geometry and batch representativeness constrain scale-up. Internal table encoding and uncertainty estimates remain unverified. No archive or fragment images were downloaded, particle dimensions recalculated or sorting efficiency predicted.
